title: oncall handoff draft - sam park
content:
Oncall Handoff (DRAFT) - Sam Park
Shift: Night (UTC) 2026-02-28 -> 2026-03-01
Summary: quiet-ish night overall. Two alerts of note: a brief spike in 5xxs from api-prod in us-west-2 (~00:12 UTC), and degraded throughput on dedicated pool gpu-pool-3 (~03:40 UTC). Both self-graded as P2/P3; mitigations applied and follow-ups logged.

INCIDENTS
- 2026-02-28 00:12 UTC - api-prod 5xx spike (approx 3m)
  - Symptoms: sudden increase in 5xx error rate to ~4% for /v1/generate routes. Latency also increased ~120ms p95.
  - Initial triage: alerts pointed to transient 502s from ingress NGINX. Checked logs: upstream responses included "context cancelled" and a few "connection reset by peer". No changes/deploys during window.
  - Mitigation taken: rolled back a canary route config that had a shorter idle timeout (was pushed earlier in the day). Restarted 2 ingress pods which cleared the errors.
  - Follow-up: create a ticket to add stricter monitoring on idle timeouts and a dashboard for ingress upstream errors (JIRA-OPS-988). Owner: Aisha.
  - Notes: unclear if underlying cause is infra (k8s node pressure) or client-side. Keep an eye for recurrence.

- 2026-02-28 03:40 UTC - dedicated pool gpu-pool-3 degraded throughput
  - Symptoms: sustained increase in queue length for gpu-pool-3, throughput down ~30% for 45m. Autoscaler did not trigger additional nodes.
  - Triage: node-level GPU utilization low but several pods reporting OOMKilled in logs (memory cgroup spikes). The autoscaler config had a bug in the threshold comparison (float-int mismatch) — hit before in canary.
  - Mitigation: manually scaled pool by +2 nodes to drain queue. Reclaimed capacity and backlog cleared.
  - Follow-up: PR to fix autoscaler threshold comparison merged but needs rollout to prod (PR link in linked_artifacts). Schedule rollout during low-traffic window. Owner: Noah.

ONGOING TICKETS / WORK ITEMS
- JIRA-OPS-987: "Improve ingress error observability" - in progress. Aisha leading.
- JIRA-OPS-988: "Autoscaler threshold bug & safer rollout" - high priority, blocked on canary validation.
- RND-314: "Investigate KV cache memory growth" - saw slight mem creep on some runtime versions; add long-term trace.

TEMP PROCEDURES / RUNBOOK DRAFT NOTES (temporary steps to use until PR is fully rolled out)
- If 5xx spike on /v1/generate:
  1) Check NGINX upstream error logs: kubectl logs -n ingress -l app=nginx-ingress --tail 200
  2) Check recent route config changes: kubectl get configmap route-config -o yaml (look for idle_timeout overrides)
  3) If canary route recently updated, roll back canary by patching annotation: kubectl patch configmap route-config -p '{"data":{"canary":"off"}}'
  4) If ingress pods show errors, restart 1-2 pods to avoid full disruption: kubectl rollout restart deployment/nginx-ingress -n ingress
  5) Notify infra channel (#infra) with summary and link to logs.

- If dedicated pool throughput degrades:
  1) Check pool status dashboard (Console -> Dedicated -> Pools -> gpu-pool-3) for queue length and node health.
  2) Check pod logs for OOMKilled: kubectl get pods -n dedicated -l pool=gpu-pool-3 --field-selector=status.phase!=Running -o wide; kubectl describe pod <pod>
  3) If autoscaler not triggering, scale manually: kubectl scale statefulset gpu-pool-3 --replicas=<current+2> -n dedicated
  4) If scaling fails due to capacity, trigger fallback to compatible model variant (route policy -> lower memory variant) — see console playbook link (CONFLUENCE-12345).
  5) Open/annotate JIRA ticket with timeframe and steps taken.

ESCALATION CONTACTS
- Primary SRE oncall (day): Aisha Rahman - slack @aisha - pager: +1-555-0102
- Secondary SRE: Noah Thompson - slack @noah - pager: +1-555-0103
- Platform eng lead (for autoscale/infra issues): Priya Menon - slack @priya - pager: +1-555-0110
- Oncall EM: Jordan Lee - slack @jordan

NOTES TO NEXT ONCALL / TODOs
- Watch for recurrence of ingress 502s over next 72h. If seen, capture full traces and correlate with node metrics.
- Follow up with Aisha on dashboard completion (JIRA-OPS-987).
- Verify autoscaler fix rollout to prod tomorrow (Noah). If rollout cannot be scheduled during day, coordinate with EM.
- Consider adding a temporary runbook snippet to Console -> Rollouts for manual canary rollback button (low friction for oncall).

QUICK COMMANDS / CHEAT SHEET
- Check ingress errors: kubectl logs -n ingress -l app=nginx-ingress --since=1h
- Restart ingress: kubectl rollout restart deployment/nginx-ingress -n ingress
- Scale dedicated pool: kubectl scale statefulset gpu-pool-3 --replicas=5 -n dedicated
- Tail runtime logs: kgp -n serving -l app=runtime | xargs -I{} kubectl logs -f {} -c runtime

OPEN QUESTIONS / IDEAS
- Short-term: should we add a circuit-breaker that isolates canary route traffic if upstream 5xx spike > 1% for 2m? Pros/cons?
- Long-term: better autoscaler testing harness (simulate memory pressure in canary) before rollouts.

Notes to self: this doc is rough - will tidy and move to shared runbooks/confluence after next-day cleanup. Add exact dashboard links when Aisha shares them.

-- Sam
